title: Two people and a shared desk
description: Marta and Sam left their jobs the same month and took on one project — a booking tool for a chain of dive schools. It launched in five weeks and is still in service.

title: The six-week rule
description: After a project ran eleven months we stopped quoting by the hour and started quoting fixed scope in six-week blocks. Nothing we have done since has changed the work more.

title: Engineering comes in-house
description: We stopped handing designs to other people's developers. Design and engineering moved into the same week, and the gap between a mockup and a deploy went from months to days.

title: A studio of nine
description: Brand and growth joined the practice. We turned down the chance to double again — nine is the largest number of people who can all still hold the whole project.

title: Forty-one launches in
description: Two engagements at a time, six-week cycles, and a waiting list we are honest about. The shape has not changed much since 2019, which we take as a good sign.
